recoveredFacts: Ordinary Attack and S2 Skill_2_Loop retain original OnAttack events near 0.433 seconds in both facings; S3's selected native ability does not wait for an attack animation event.
S1 retains ally selector postFilter19, operator professionMask639, range_radius1.5, initial ATK caching and a sourceless MAGICAL receipt followed by FIRE injury derived from actual output damage.
S2 preserves its ground-tile ability, enemy on-tile slow, per-period MAGICAL/FIRE outputs and separate leave-tile and skill-finish cleanup templates. The direct projectile speed is99.

S3 preserves a0.3-second delayed immediate-region projectile, its original stop-only hit checker with ignoreCamouflage1, separate burst-only ELEMENT bonus and an ammo-recovery listener before FIRE burst start.

The first talent has distinct before-FIRE-burst healing and on-FIRE-burst ELEMENT output. The revival chain retains HP-zero interception, barrier dynamic value, regeneration, full-HP triggers, original Revive clips and CauseStun sequencing.

All thirty source ranks, three reachable projectile trees, twenty-two native templates and both original skeleton pointer chains are retained; native method bodies, callback clocks, enum mappings, modules, effects/audio and complete regular-stage gameplay remain unverified.
